chemical_life_science_product_family.label: Chemical / life-science product family
chemical_life_science_product_family.value: Specialty materials: advanced materials (interlayers, films, copolyesters), additives and functional products, chemical intermediates, and fibers

specialty_commodity_positioning.label: Specialty / commodity positioning
specialty_commodity_positioning.value: Mostly application-specific specialty materials, with some commodity-like intermediates; molecular recycling positioned as premium sustainable offering

formulation_synthesis_complexity.label: Formulation / synthesis complexity
formulation_synthesis_complexity.value: Multistep chemical synthesis and integrated production from shared feedstock streams, plus custom additive formulation and polymer processing

patent_exclusivity_dependence.label: Patent / exclusivity dependence
patent_exclusivity_dependence.value: Process know-how, proprietary technology and product patents, such as recycling technology and copolyesters; not dependent on single-product exclusivity

product_specific_regulatory_route.label: Product-specific regulatory route
product_specific_regulatory_route.value: TSCA and REACH chemical compliance, plus food-contact and other product-specific approvals

r_d_intensity.label: R&D intensity
r_d_intensity.value: Moderate R&D spending as a share of sales, typical of a specialty materials company with innovation focus

notes: No website evidence was provided; facets are based on general knowledge of Eastman.
